question.text: In the illustrative deal-by-deal distribution waterfall for a closed-ended Cat I/II AIF (per Chapter 6, Table 6.1), which item is paid FIRST in the priority sequence?

answer.text: Residual distribution to investors/managers in carry ratio

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Table 6.1 waterfall: (1) Expenses, taxes, statutory payments, (2) Reserves, (3) Management Fees and other costs, (4) Net proceeds (first to repay corpus, then preferred return), (5) Catch-up / carry, (6) Residual distribution. Expenses-first ensures the fund meets obligations before distributing anything. **The Trap:** A is step 4; B is step 5; D is step 6. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same waterfall is mirrored in XIX-C. PE/VC convention worldwide; SEBI does not mandate waterfall order — it is a PPM-level disclosure. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Document the waterfall AS A FLOWCHART in your PPM. Text-only descriptions cause disputes; a one-page flow diagram is the LP-friendliest disclosure and protects you at the distribution date.
